name: The Preacher
description:
'The Preacher of Love' cannot stop talking about love. He tries to convince others that love is the only power that can save humankind from destruction. He has reached a certain status of bliss by beginning to put his acquired knowledge into practice. 

Nevertheless, caution is advised here, because it is not a matter of listening to the honeyed words of a preacher, but it's essential that each individual finds and walks his own path.
